summary: Bounds-checked index into a fixed-stride array owned by `this`: validates a2 against the element count stored at this[2] (offset 0x8), returning 0 when out of range, otherwise returning the address this[3] + 108 * a2 (offset 0xC holds the array base; element stride is 108 bytes). Structural twin of ShortComputation_c910 (0040c910) per cluster_copy.

operations.description: Reject index a2 when it is negative or at/above the element count stored at this[2] (offset 0x8).
Return 0 as the invalid-access sentinel when the bounds check fails.
Compute the target element address as this[3] (array base at offset 0xC) plus 108 * a2 (element stride).
Return the computed element address for a valid index.
Used by HATPolygonSurfaceFit (00449A80), AnimationPlaybackSequence (0044ACB0) and sub_4CEF30 (004CEF30) to obtain validated per-element pointers into their fixed-stride arrays.

clean_pseudocode: return this->base + 108 * a2;     // this[3], offset 0xC, stride 0x6C
unresolved: Element type and array semantics of the 108-byte stride are caller-defined and not established here.
Identity of the owning class (container of count/base fields) is unknown.
